{
  "requirements": [
    {"id": 1, "text": "A dice-throwing game for three players."},
    {"id": 2, "text": "Every player starts with 0 points."},
    {"id": 3, "text": "The players take turns."},
    {"id": 4, "text": "In each turn, a player must throw a dice."},
    {"id": 5, "text": "The dice count gets added to the player's points."},
    {"id": 6, "text": "After each turn, the system prints the dice count and the player points."},
    {"id": 7, "text": "The game ends after 12 turns."},
    {"id": 8, "text": "The game also terminates if one player has significantly more points than the others."},
    {"id": 9, "text": "If the dice count is 1, the player shall decide whether to re-roll the dice."},
    {"id": 10, "text": "There will be a congratulatory message for the winner."},
    {"id": 11, "text": "The player point colors shall always be red for player 1, green for player 2, and blue for player 3."},
    {"id": 12, "text": "If a player's points are sufficient to win, his point color shall turn purple."},
    {"id": 13, "text": "If the current player throws a 6, his turn must not continue."},
    {"id": 14, "text": "If the dice count is 2, it shall be tripled. If the dice count is even, it shall be halved."},
    {"id": 15, "text": "The game shall check the players' points at any point in the game. If they turn equal, it shall print: 'Equality!'."},
    {"id": 16, "text": "The players' turn order shall be decided at the beginning of the game."},
    {"id": 17, "text": "Names shall be entered for each player. If 'Computer' is entered, the system shall print 'Name cannot be Computer' and ask for the name again."},
    {"id": 18, "text": "If the dice count is high, the player shall throw again and multiply both dice counts."},
    {"id": 19, "text": "When a player's points get above 5 points, his point color shall turn purple."},
    {"id": 20, "text": "In each turn, the player shall not skip his turn."},
    {"id": 21, "text": "If a player throws the same value multiple times in a row, his points shall be reset to 0."},
    {"id": 22, "text": "If two players have the same amount of points, the game shall not end until one player has more points than the other."},
    {"id": 23, "text": "The system shall print the players' points and the winner after a game has ended."},
    {"id": 24, "text": "After the game has ended, one player shall be the winner."},
    {"id": 25, "text": "If the players decide to play again, the players shall be ordered in a certain way."}
  ]
}
